seed_semantics: planner/global seed=scene+seed; environment reset seed=scene, same paired traffic

methods.B: Causal steering low-pass, exact original throttle
methods.C: Comfort-aware Local MPPI, exact original throttle

lowpass.formula: alpha*u_SAC+(1-alpha)*actual_previous, clipped around current SAC; throttle unchanged

objective: two directly measurable action terms only: equally normalized steering rate and steering second difference; no unvalidated physical jerk or TerminalQ

comfort_index.definition: mean of raw steering_rate_RMS and SG-filtered actual longitudinal_jerk_RMS/lateral_jerk_RMS/lateral_accel_RMS normalized by map-level development medians

offline_filter: 5point Savitzky-Golay poly2 at dt0.1, identical allgroups; raw metrics retained; never used online
hard_braking_definition: data-derived P95 of development actual negative acceleration; episode event starts, not a universal emergency threshold

acceptance.comfort_C_vs_B: paired improvement or comparable comfort with credible task benefit; no baseline-only success claim
acceptance.interval_rule: map bootstrap95% must support conditions; wide intervals=insufficient evidence
